aboutSection.heading: Bangalore's
aboutSection.description: Based in Sahakarnagar, Bangalore, we are a seasoned elevator solutions provider with over 30 years of industry experience. Since 2012 alone, we have successfully executed more than 2,000 elevator installations across a diverse range of projects—including hospitals, residential apartments, villas, and industrial warehouses. We specialize in end-to-end, customized lift solutions and are especially known for our precision in installations where others deem the shaft requirements unfeasible. Our legacy is built on engineering excellence, adaptability, and a relentless commitment to client satisfaction.

solutionsSection.heading: Smart Vertical Solutions for Every Need
solutionsSection.description: BG Elevators offers smart elevator solutions for residential, commercial, and heavy-duty spaces — combining safety, efficiency, and custom design
solutionsSection.description2: Designed for comfort, speed, and style, our Passenger Elevators cater to residential and commercial buildings alike. Whether it’s a high-rise structure or a mid-level facility, our solutions ensure smooth, silent, and safe vertical transport with customizable features to match your building's aesthetic and functional requirements.

items.heading: Hospital Elevator
items.description: Specially engineered for medical environments, our Hospital Elevators prioritize space, hygiene, and reliability. Built to accommodate stretchers, wheelchairs, and medical equipment, these elevators offer precise leveling, smooth movement, and are designed to support critical hospital workflows with maximum safety and ease of use.

items.heading: Goods Elevator
items.description: Our Goods Elevators are engineered to meet the rigorous demands of industrial and commercial spaces. Designed for transporting heavy materials, they feature high load capacity, sturdy construction, and smooth vertical movement. Whether for warehouses, factories, or retail storage areas, these elevators offer reliable performance, durability, and low maintenance.

items2.description: MRL (Machine Room Less) has an advantage of saving power upto 30%. Its absolutely noiseless, smoothest and quicker ride ever for which the passenger enjoys the ride.
Though its little more in price when compared to MR, customer feels its worth for its flawless movement. It does not need a machine room.

solutionsSection.description3: Our Home Elevators are crafted to elevate everyday living with comfort, elegance, and convenience. Ideal for multi-level homes and villas, these lifts are compact, stylish, and operate quietly. We offer fully customized designs that seamlessly match your interior aesthetics while prioritizing safety features like smooth stops, backup power, and child-friendly operation.

items3.description: Hydraulic elevators are mostly used in the houses with 4-5 floors. Customer prefers this type when they have limitations in the space on the top and bottom as it consumes less space,customised for client requirements.
It operates with little lower speed than the traction elevators.

faqSection.heading: Helpful Answers for
faqSection.description: Clear guidance for planning, installation, maintenance and ongoing elevator support.

items.question: What information is helpful before a site inspection?
items.answer: Building type, number of floors, expected usage, available shaft space and preferred elevator capacity help our team understand the project before inspecting the site.

items.question: How does BG Elevators recommend the right elevator system?
items.answer: Our team reviews the site conditions, travel requirements, available space, safety needs and expected usage before recommending a suitable elevator configuration.

items.question: What happens during elevator installation?
items.answer: The process includes site coordination, system installation, alignment, electrical integration, safety checks, testing and a final handover walkthrough.

items.question: Why is preventive elevator maintenance important?
items.answer: Scheduled inspections help identify wear early, support reliable operation, reduce unexpected stoppages and maintain safe performance over time.

items.question: Can an existing elevator be modernized?
items.answer: Yes. Depending on its condition, an elevator can be upgraded through controls, drives, safety systems, fixtures, doors and cabin improvements.

items.question: Do you service elevators installed by other companies?
items.answer: Yes. BG Elevators provides inspection, maintenance and repair support for eligible non-BG elevator systems after assessing their condition and service requirements.
